## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Only optional corrections were found in the reviewed scope: `test_rejects_legacy_header` passes for the wrong reason. The header check itself is correct, and `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` exercises it.

## Changes
`parse_report` now accepts only the exact header `REPORT v1`; before this change it accepted any header starting with `REPORT `. The pull request also adds two tests that check unsupported headers are rejected.

## Suggestions
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Make the legacy-header fixture complete and change its header — `rsplit("v1", 1)` swaps the last `v1`, so the fixture becomes `"REPORT v1\nversion=v0"`. The header is still `v1`, and the fixture has no `END` line. `parse_report` therefore returns `None` from the `END` check at `app/report.py:3`, even with the old `startswith` check, which contradicts the comment at line 9 ("changing the fixture's version to v0"). — This test cannot catch a regression in the version check, and its comment misdescribes what it covers. — Fix: Use `"REPORT v0\nvalue=ok\nEND"`, or delete this test because `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` already covers that input.
